units: millimeters for geometry, kilograms for mass
notes: Manufacturer nominal exterior envelope and mass; independent approximate enclosure, aperture positions, ports, mounting reference, center of mass and uniform-envelope inertia. No optical calibration, calibrated stereo baseline or simulated depth output. Nominal mass tolerance is ±10%; bulk units may omit the USB cap (approximately 2.3 g). No cable or bracket included.
